display.purpose: Section headings and page titles. Largest text on screen.

label.purpose: Stat labels, form labels, section navigation. Always uppercase with tracked spacing.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Hover state feedback on buttons and interactive cards.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Modal and overlay separation from base layer.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold CTA for primary actions. Dark text on gold background.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 18px; background: #e8a838; color: #111; border: 1px solid #e8a838; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(232,168,56,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(232,168,56,0.15); } .ds-btn-icon { font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with subtle border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 18px; background: transparent; color: #e2e2e6; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Metric display: icon + label + value. No side-stripe accent.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 20px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 10px; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-stat-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } .ds-stat-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-stat-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 11px; color: #71717a; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #e2e2e6; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Dark glass input with gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 8px; color: #e2e2e6; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; outline: none; color-scheme: dark; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #71717a; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #e8a838; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(232,168,56,0.15); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar nav link with gold active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 20px; color: #71717a; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; border-left: 3px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #e2e2e6; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-nav-active { color: #e8a838; background: rgba(232,168,56,0.10); border-left-color: #e8a838; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tag-income { background: rgba(34,197,94,0.10); color: #22c55e; } .ds-tag-expense { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.10); color: #ef4444; }

narrative.overview: A cashier's workspace that feels solid and trustworthy, like a well-lit mahogany counter in a premium restaurant. Warm dark tones ground the interface. Gold accents mark where attention should go but never compete. Every screen answers one question fast: what do I need to do right now?
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark: backgrounds tinted toward warm gray, never pure black
Restrained accent: gold used sparingly, for primary actions and active states only
Data-first: numbers and labels dominate, decoration is minimal
Vietnamese-native: DM Sans renders Vietnamese diacritics cleanly at all sizes
Scannable: clear type hierarchy lets cashiers glance, not study

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: King's Gold appears on no more than 15% of any screen. It marks interactive affordances and active states. When everything is gold, nothing is.

rules.name: The No Decoration Rule
rules.body: Semantic colors (green, red, amber, blue) indicate data status only. They are never used for backgrounds, gradients, or ornamentation.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: DM Sans carries every role. Hierarchy comes from weight, size, and letter-spacing, never from a second typeface.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every financial figure uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Columns of money amounts must align vertically without exception.

rules.name: The Flat-Rest Rule
rules.body: No element has a shadow at rest. Shadows appear only as feedback (hover) or to separate layers (modals).

dos: Do use King's Gold (#e8a838) exclusively for primary actions, active states, and the brand mark.
Do use tonal layering (#111318 → #181b23 → rgba surface) for depth. Three tones, no more.
Do use tabular-nums on every column of financial data.
Do use uppercase + letter-spacing (0.04em) for labels; negative letter-spacing (-0.02em) for headings.
Do keep Vietnamese diacritics readable at every size.
Do keep modals small and focused.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards.
Don't use backdrop-filter: blur() decoratively on sidebars or topbars.
Don't use purple gradients, neon glows, or cyan accents.
Don't use background-clip: text with gradient backgrounds.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing.
Don't add glow shadows to elements at rest.
Don't use Inter, Roboto, Geist, or Plus Jakarta Sans.
Don't animate width, height, padding, or margin.
Don't wrap every piece of content in a bordered card.
